title: Kneeling in the rain; the Demon Sect gathers at Liubo Mountain
summary: A strong evil aura comes off Zhang Xiaofan and he fights Song Daren. Tian Buyi orders him to kneel and repent, and sends Lin Jingyu, who tries to stand by him, back with Qi Hao. Bi Yao slips onto the peak and finds Xiaofan in the rain; she prays to the Wisdom King and the Holy Mother for him, but he insists he deserves punishment. In the morning Tian Buyi tells him that Tian Ling'er loves Qi Hao and sees him only as a younger brother, and gives him a mission. Searching Liubo Mountain with Ling'er, Xiaofan finds a cave where Demon Sect members are waiting for the Kui, a divine beast seen every 3,000 years, and are demanding the Ghost King explain himself. Bi Yao speaks for her father; Baiduzi and Elder Duanmu of the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect argue about whether to stay. Bi Yao exposes a man sowing discord as a Qingyun spy by his Taiji Xuanqing Dao and Seven Star Sword. Xiaofan and Ling'er jump in to help him, and he turns out to be Xiao Yicai. Bi Yao uses the Hehuan Bell, and the Ghost King appears and warns her that it backfires on the unskilled.
